to_measure.motor_pcd / motor_hole / bell_pcd: GL60 stator-base and bell mounting hole PCDs and threads (manufacturer drawing could not be fetched): the flange and the disc carry BOTH patterns
to_measure.GL60 lead exit: where the three phase leads leave the stator base (OD or bore side); the flange channel runs from the OD to the bore so either works
to_measure.motor_od / motor_len / motor_bore: confirm 69.0 x 22.3 mm and the 20 mm through-bore on the delivered revision
to_measure.tube_id: measure the real 3.0 x 0.065 in tube bore (+-0.15); bore both ends 72.90 H8 x 12 deep and cut the cap O-ring grooves to that
to_measure.Speedi-Sleeve 99059: confirm the sleeve width (modelled 6.0) and SKF's advice on an anodised aluminium journal; fallback = run the PTFE lip on the hard-anodised 15 h6 journal (Ra 0.4)
to_measure.lip seal: PTFE pressure-rated lip seal in the 15x22x4 (min76) / 15x24x5 (robust) envelope (Trelleborg Varilip PDR or equivalent); confirm availability, else Freudenberg BABSL 15x24x5
to_measure.DIN 471-15 lug envelope: confirm the installed outside dimension across the lugs fits the 24 mm recess

print_orientation.dome: base face down on the bed, no supports; 100 % infill (solid); ASA
print_orientation.drive_disc: flat on the bed, dogs up (TPU 95A, 100 % infill, no supports; counterbores print as holes from the top)
print_orientation.carrier: pad up, arc standing like a bridge with its axis along the bed X (the airfoil pocket opens upward and prints without internal support); brim; tree supports under the arc (bore), lips and ears; ASA, 4 perimeters, 100 % infill in the pad/pocket/ears zone, 40 % gyroid elsewhere. Axis-vertical was rejected: the pocket roof would be a 39 mm flat overhang needing internal support in a 0.15 mm fit.
print_orientation.blade: pressure side down with the span along the bed X, tilted about Y so the root and tip low points are level (done in the STL); tongue at the root end lies flat; organic/tree supports with an interface layer under the leading- and trailing-edge overhangs, brim; ASA, 100 % infill; layers run along the span
print_orientation.duct: ring axis vertical; three 120-degree arcs with 20 mm lap joints (2x M3 each, laps not modelled) because the ring is 237 mm over the clevises; ASA, 3 perimeters, 30 % infill
